_comment: Source of truth for certificates (owner decision 2026-10-05: one certificate per roadmap track). _build/build_tracks_manifest.py reads each track's published lessons from courses.json (roadmap.track) and their graded checks from functions/_data/exercise-manifest.json, and emits functions/_data/tracks.json, which the runtime bundles into the Function. A certificate is earned at `threshold` (0.8) of the graded checks across the track's published lessons. `open: false` = not claimable yet (track still being published); flip it to true when the track is complete. `free: true` = mintable without Pro.

issuer.name: r-statistics.co
issuer.description: Educational resource for machine learning and statistical computing in R, founded and authored by Selva Prabhakaran.

tracks.name: Certified R Fundamentals
tracks.tagline: The R language itself: data types, data frames, control flow and your own functions.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the New to R track: base R data types and vectors, lists and data frames, subsetting, control flow and functions, importing real data, strings and dates, iteration, defensive code and a reproducible workflow.

tracks.name: Certified R Data Analyst
tracks.mastery: data analysis and reporting in R
tracks.tagline: Turn raw data into tables, charts and reports with dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2 and Quarto.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the Data Analyst track: wrangling and tidying with dplyr and tidyr, joins and reshaping, exploratory analysis, ggplot2 from first chart to publication figure, data.table for big data, report-ready tables, interactive output and reproducible reporting.

tracks.name: Certified R Data Scientist
tracks.tagline: Build, tune, evaluate and explain predictive models with tidymodels.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the Data Scientist track: the ML workflow, regression and classification, trees and gradient boosting, tidymodels, feature engineering, resampling and tuning, calibrated classification, unsupervised learning, interpretability and shipping models.

tracks.name: Certified R Forecaster
tracks.tagline: Forecast with ETS, ARIMA, state space and machine learning models, and measure them honestly.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the Forecaster track: time series foundations and decomposition, the forecasting toolbox, regression, ETS and ARIMA, dynamic regression, state space models, spectral analysis, volatility, multivariate and hierarchical forecasting, ML and deep forecasting, and production forecasting.

tracks.name: Certified R Researcher
tracks.tagline: Choose and defend the right statistical method, and report it reproducibly.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the Researcher track: estimation and the bootstrap, inference and test selection, ANOVA and regression strategies, GLMs, mixed-effects and additive models, Bayesian analysis, experimental design, causal inference, survival analysis and reproducible reporting.

tracks.name: Certified R Developer
tracks.tagline: Write fast, tested, documented R and ship it as packages, APIs and apps.
tracks.description: Awarded for completing the R Developer track: functional and object-oriented R, environments and evaluation, metaprogramming, conditions and debugging, performance and Rcpp, parallel R, packages, testing and CI, Shiny, databases and deployment.
